title: Usher Has Concert Audience Member 21 Savage Sing Hit Single 'My Boo' [Watch]
htmlContent:
At Usher's recent concert, fans were thrilled to see the unexpected appearance of rapper 21 Savage in the crowd. As Usher began to perform his classic hit "My Boo," and handed 21 Savage a microphone for him to join in, belting out the lyrics along with the rest of the audience. The impromptu performance quickly went viral on social media, with fans sharing clips of the unlikely collaboration between the two artists.

While 21 Savage is primarily known for his work in the hip-hop genre, his participation in the performance demonstrated his willingness to step outside of his comfort zone and explore different musical styles. It also highlighted the power of music to bring people together, as fans of all ages and backgrounds sang and danced along to the familiar tune. Overall, the surprise appearance of 21 Savage at Usher's concert was a reminder of the magic of live music and the unexpected moments that can make a concert truly unforgettable.

Speaking of 21 Savage, he was recently seen onstage at Coachella along with Metro Boomin, The Weeknd, and P Diddy.

Metro Boomin's Coachella set this year was one for the books, as he brought out a host of musicians and special guests to perform tracks from his latest album, HEROES & VILLAINS. The star producer did not disappoint, as he seamlessly mixed tracks and brought out almost all of the album's guests to perform alongside him, including Future, Don Toliver, 21 Savage, The Weeknd, and even Diddy.

The transitions between songs were also well done, fitting seamlessly even if they weren't album tracks. The audience was treated to a high-energy set with classics galore, accompanied by a visually engaging component featuring comic books and dramatic art. To top it all off, the set began with a Coachella-specific intro from Morgan Freeman, adding to the overall experience.

Overall, Metro Boomin's Coachella set was an incredible display of his talent and the impressive range of his latest album. With special guests, great mixing, and a visually stunning performance, Metro Boomin proved why he is one of the top producers in the game. It was undoubtedly a memorable set that fans will be talking about for years to come.
